title: Gold Miner Classic
description: Time your swinging brass claw to haul up giant gold nuggets, sparkling diamonds, and mystery sacks before the clock runs out across handcrafted underground mines.
controls: Click, tap, or press Space/Down to launch the swinging claw. Press E or click Dynamite while reeling in heavy rocks to blast them away.

zh-CN.title: 黄金矿工
zh-CN.description: 国民级经典回忆杀：瞄准摆动的矿工铁爪抓起大金块、闪亮钻石与神秘钱袋，活用炸药与关间商店道具冲击高分。
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕或按空格/下方向键放出铁爪抓取金块与钻石；抓到沉重石头时可按 E 或点右下角炸药炸毁。
